name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme with high-contrast interactive charts. It matches Manus’s competitive analysis and Graphify Dashboard, ensuring consistency with proven user preferences. The trade-off is reduced readability for users sensitive to bright screens, but the liveliness and clarity of dark mode outweigh this for our screencast-focused goal.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail in daylight glare—users won’t tolerate squinting at screens outdoors or near windows. A light theme with a dark accent keeps readability without sacrificing contrast, and a quick A/B test in bright vs. dim lighting settles it.
